purpose: Validate the two original Prepared operation scopes with the existing native component fixtures and one changed-scope/withdrawal regression. This is not complete native NoUpdate or adoption.
required: The whole source and Cargo.lock must match before and after. Preserve compilation failures, empty selections, timeouts and original nextest XML/logs. Zero native cases cannot qualify the candidate.
cost_scope: Record original command wall, owner wall, child CPU and maximum RSS separately; build cost remains separate from native test durations. Physical system energy, network, storage and charges are unknown unless actually measured.
